kicker: Chapter 18 · Ship it, and see if they miss it
title: Ship it. Give it away. Take it away. Ask.
subtitle: Then do whatever the answer tells you, including the thing you did not want to hear.
alt: Four boxes in a row: ship, give it away, take it away, ask: do they miss it? Two branches. If they shrug and go back to their day, you do not have a product yet. If they come back and ask for it, you have something, and two questions follow: is the price one they are happy to pay, and is that price profitable for you? A note above: before you ask whether a stranger misses it, ask whether you would.
